run_lk_training: run the Lucas-Kanade optical flow training loop with video and image evaluation datasets
run_lk_evaluation_only: run the model evaluation once without training by setting the eval_once flag
obtain_lk_args: create an argparse CLI to parse Lucas-Kanade training arguments including model and optimizer configs
obtain_model: build a Lucas-Kanade optical flow network from model and LK configuration files
obtain_optimizer: create an optimizer, learning rate scheduler, and loss criterion for the network
